prompt.alinti: Claude Design can now finally build websites that don't look AI-generated, and all you need are these four simple plugins.
Without these four installs, every single website that you ask Claude to do is just going to look exactly the same, so here's how we're going to solve it.
The first one is the Emil Kowalski design skill. Emil trained thousands of developers using animation.dev on how to take static websites and turn them into animated, fully-fledged websites.
The second one is impeccable. This works on all the spacing, typography, and color gradients on your website so that your UI actually looks unique.
The third one is taste. This one makes Claude search for high-performing websites, take what works from them, and then use it as context when building yours.

The fourth one is the Figma MCP and Playwright. This one makes it so that Claude can actually screenshot its own work and double-check itself before it ships you something that it's not even looked at.
If you want to build websites like this and get all of these installs, just comment 'websites' and hit follow, and I'll shoot it over to you.
